Three ways in.
All end with a van outside.
07:00–21:00 for bookings. All night for emergencies, obviously.
Attach a photo or a video of the noise. Quotes back within the hour, working days.
Can't talk in a meeting? Text 'LEAK' and an address. We take it from there.
Updated every morning when the vans load up. 'One slot' means exactly that, we don't do artificial scarcity, only the genuine kind.
Emergencies jump every queue. That's what the queue is for.
Do you actually arrive in the window?
We book two-hour windows and hit 94% of them. The other 6% get a call before the window closes, not after.
Yes. If the wall hides a horror, we stop, show you photos, and re-quote before touching anything else. You can always say no.
One of nine staff engineers, name texted ahead, DBS-checked, in a Rivet van. No mystery subcontractors, no 'my mate Dave'.
Dust sheets down before toolboxes open. We bring our own vacuum and we use it. The sweep-up is part of the job, not a favour.
Burst pipe? No power? The 24/7 line: 0800 4 RIVET

meta_description: Call, email or text: three ways to book, this week's real availability, and honest answers to the usual questions.
